title: tpm2-tools slice 3 owes: a timed-out tool must let the CLI exit (#301 round 2 new 4)
description: After a tool_timeout the runTool pipe reads and child.exited stay pending, src/cli/ward.ts exits explicitly only when a provider reports abandonedCall, and only the direct child is killed (a grandchild is orphaned). Slice 3 at the latest: the TPM2 KeyProvider reports a timed-out tool through abandonedCall so the CLI exits explicitly, or runTool cancels its readers and unrefs the child on timeout; and if Bun supports it, spawn the tool in its own process group and kill the group.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A command whose tpm2 tool timed out exits after writing its output instead of waiting for a pipe or a stuck child, shown by a test
A tool spawned by the adapter and its grandchildren are killed together on timeout, or the task records why Bun cannot
